category_name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) - Hisn al-Muslim 107
arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً
tags: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)

category_name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) - Hisn al-Muslim 107
arabic: لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ
tags: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)

category_name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) - Hisn al-Muslim 107
arabic: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ
tags: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)

category_name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) - Hisn al-Muslim 107
arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ
tags: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)

category_name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ) - Hisn al-Muslim 107
arabic: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ
tags: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
